200.description:
One mediamarkt.nl product page by article number or URL: name, brand, EAN, EUR price, strike price, rating, marketplace seller, delivery and pickup availability, category path, images and the full specification table.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `badges` | string[] | Promotion badges shown on the product, e.g. bundle deals. |
| `brand` | string | Manufacturer as the site writes it, e.g. `SONY`. |
| `category_path` | object[] | Breadcrumb from the top category down. |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string | Every price in this output is in euro. |
| `delivery` | object | Home delivery availability without a postcode, as the storefront shows it. |
| `ean` | string | EAN/GTIN barcode when the site publishes one. |
| `image` | string | Main product image. |
| `images` | string[] | Product gallery images. |
| `kind_of_product` | string | The site's product type code, e.g. `HEADPHONES`. |
| `marketplace` | boolean | True when the product is a marketplace listing sold by a third party. |
| `marketplace_seller` | object | The third-party seller of a marketplace offer; null for products MediaMarkt sells itself. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the program read the source. |
| `online_status` | string | Online status code, e.g. `AVAILABLE`, `MP_OFFER` (marketplace offer), `NOT_AVAILABLE`. |
| `pickup` | object | Store pickup availability without a selected store. |
| `price` | number | Current price in EUR incl. VAT as shown; null when the product has no active offer. |
| `product_id` | string | MediaMarkt article number (the number at the end of the product URL). |
| `rating` | object | Null when the product has no reviews. |
| `specs` | object[] | Specification table in page order. |
| `strike_price` | number | Crossed-out reference price in EUR, only when the site strikes it through. |
| `strike_price_type` | string | Kind of strike price the site reports, e.g. `LOP` (lowest previous price) or `RRP`. |
| `url` | string | Canonical product page on www.mediamarkt.nl. |

200.description:
Keyword search on mediamarkt.nl: one page of 12 products with article number, name, brand, EUR price, strike price, rating, marketplace seller, and delivery and pickup availability. Queries the site maps to a category (for example `sony koptelefoon`) return that category listing (`result_type: category_redirect`); queries it cannot match return the site's fallback suggestions (`result_type: fallback`). Up to 30 pages.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `category` | object | The category listing the query redirected to; null otherwise. |
| `count` | number | Items on this page. |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string | Every price in this output is in euro. |
| `has_more` | boolean |  |
| `items` | object[] |  |
| `matched_query` | string | The query the site's search engine actually ran after spelling standardization; null for fallback and category redirects. |
| `next_page` | number | Pass as `page` (with the same `query`) for the next page; null when this is the last page the site serves (at most 30). |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the program read the source. |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number | Products per page; 12 on mediamarkt.nl. |
| `pages` | number | Pages the site reports. |
| `query` | string | The query as sent (whitespace collapsed). |
| `result_type` | string | `search`: keyword results. `category_redirect`: the site sent the query to a category listing (see `category`). `fallback`: the site matched nothing and filled the page with its own suggestions (`matched_query` is null). |
| `total` | number | Products the site reports for the query (or for the category it redirected to). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
